description:
Live check of one store's fulfillment provider connection: does the credential still work, and is anything on the provider side blocking orders. `healthy` is true (working), false (the merchant must act) or null (could not tell: the provider was throttling or unreachable; do NOT ask the user to reconnect on null). Some providers (Toolbox POD) also return an itemised report: `checks` (token, me, scopes, mode, purchasing, webhook), each with `ok` true, false or null (unknown), and `fixes`, plain sentences telling the merchant exactly what to switch on. Relay every `fixes` entry to the user word for word. `checks.purchasing.ok` false means no spending limit is set, so paid orders will wait until the merchant turns purchasing on in their Toolbox POD account. `mode` "test" is a sandbox connection that never charges or prints. Use after connecting a provider, and whenever orders are stuck before production. Read-only on the merchant's data, but it does call the provider (an OAuth probe may refresh the stored access token), so do not poll it: use check_connection_status for polling.

[#37be56]

workspace.description: Workspace uuid the store lives in (agency accounts) — use the store's workspace.uuid from list_my_stores. Omit only for single-workspace accounts; omitting it on a multi-workspace account targets the Default workspace and the call will fail to find a store that lives elsewhere.

name: check_fulfillment_connection
title: Check a fulfillment provider connection
